checks.title: Xac nhan gui yeu cau voi amount mac dinh -> tao Invoice pending, balance ve $0
checks.precondition: Affiliate da du dieu kien canCreateByUser (xem checklist payout-request-eligibility); balance hien tai > 0.
steps: Mo modal 'Request Payment', de trong truong so tien.
Xac nhan gui yeu cau tren modal.
Doc lai status Invoice moi va User.balance ngay sau khi xac nhan.
checks.observation_point: Invoice.status va User.balance ngay sau khi xac nhan tren portal.
checks.expected_result: 1 Invoice moi duoc tao voi status = pending, amount = toan bo balance truoc do; User.balance giam ve $0 NGAY LAP TUC (du Invoice con pending, chua thanh toan thuc).

checks.title: Xac nhan gui yeu cau voi amount tuy nhap (nho hon balance) -> Invoice dung so tien do, balance chi tru dung amount
checks.precondition: Affiliate du dieu kien canCreateByUser; balance hien tai du lon (vd $100); fee cua payment method da chon = $2.
steps: Nhap mot amount cu the nho hon balance va lon hon fee (vd $40).
Xac nhan gui yeu cau.
Doc lai Invoice.amount va User.balance.
checks.observation_point: Invoice.amount va User.balance sau khi tao.
checks.expected_result: Invoice duoc tao voi amount = $40 (gia tri da nhap); User.balance giam dung $40 (tu $100 ve $60), KHONG tru toan bo balance.

Thu xac nhan gui yeu cau.

checks.observation_point: Validation message/response va danh sach Invoice cua affiliate sau khi thu.
checks.expected_result: Request bi tu choi (validation error), KHONG co Invoice moi nao duoc tao, User.balance khong doi.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Rut mot phan co rang buoc toi thieu/toi da nao ngoai '> phi va <= balance' khong
checks.precondition: Affiliate du dieu kien canCreateByUser; balance hien tai du lon.
steps: Nhap mot amount rat nho (vd ngay tren fee, +$0.01) va mot amount gan sat balance (balance - $0.01).
Thu xac nhan gui yeu cau cho ca 2 truong hop.
Quan sat ket qua.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua xac nhan gui yeu cau cho ca 2 muc amount bien.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh ngoai dieu kien da biet (> fee, <= balance) - tai lieu khong neu them rang buoc toi thieu/toi da nao khac (vd buoc tron so, gioi han so lan rut/ngay).

open_question_draft.summary: Ngoai dieu kien amount > phi va amount <= balance, rut mot phan co rang buoc toi thieu/toi da nao khac khong (vd buoc tron so, gioi han so lan/ngay)?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Moi vi du trong tai lieu deu rut tron balance; khong co bien nao rieng cho ca rut mot phan nen khong the viet test case boundary day du neu con rang buoc an chua duoc biet.

checks.title: Modal xac nhan hien day du thong tin truoc khi gui
checks.precondition: Affiliate du dieu kien canCreateByUser, da mo modal 'Request Payment'.
steps: Mo modal xac nhan gui yeu cau thanh toan.
Quan sat cac thong tin hien thi tren modal.
checks.observation_point: Noi dung hien thi tren modal xac nhan.
checks.expected_result: Modal hien day du: phuong thuc thanh toan da chon, thong tin thanh toan, so du (balance), phi (neu co), va so tien thuc nhan du kien.

checks.title: Xac nhan tren modal goi dung POST /api/invoices
checks.precondition: Affiliate du dieu kien canCreateByUser, dang o modal xac nhan.
steps: Bat network trace (hoac tuong duong).
Bam xac nhan tren modal.
Quan sat request duoc goi.
checks.observation_point: HTTP request duoc gui khi affiliate xac nhan tren modal.
checks.expected_result: 1 request POST /api/invoices duoc goi, mang theo amount (hoac rong neu dung mac dinh).

checks.title: Gui yeu cau thanh cong -> affiliate nhan email xac nhan (event RequestInvoice)
checks.precondition: Affiliate du dieu kien canCreateByUser, co email hop le.
steps: Thuc hien gui yeu cau thanh toan thanh cong.
Kiem tra hop thu/log email cua affiliate.
checks.observation_point: Email nhan duoc boi affiliate sau khi gui yeu cau thanh cong.
checks.expected_result: Affiliate nhan duoc 1 email xac nhan 'da gui yeu cau thanh toan' (event RequestInvoice).

checks.title: Invoice.code tu sinh dang {ref-affiliate}-{so-thu-tu}, gia tri unique
checks.precondition: Affiliate tao thanh cong 2 Invoice lien tiep.
steps: Tao Invoice thu 1, ghi lai code sinh ra.
Tao Invoice thu 2 (cung affiliate), ghi lai code sinh ra.
checks.expected_result: Ca 2 code theo dang '{ref-cua-affiliate}-{so-thu-tu}', so thu tu tang dan, va khong trung nhau (unique).

checks.title: payment_method_name/payment_info tren Invoice la snapshot tai thoi diem tao, khong doi theo thay doi sau cua User
checks.precondition: Affiliate tao 1 Invoice voi payment method A, sau do doi payment method sang B.
steps: Tao Invoice voi payment method A dang duoc chon.
Doi payment_method_id cua affiliate sang B (sau khi Invoice da tao).
Doc lai payment_method_name/payment_info cua Invoice da tao truoc do.
checks.observation_point: payment_method_name/payment_info luu tren Invoice sau khi affiliate doi payment method.
checks.expected_result: Invoice van giu nguyen thong tin payment method A (snapshot tai thoi diem tao), KHONG tu cap nhat theo payment method B moi.

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-010' hien trace toi kb_id (KB-010) co confirmation_source.derivation=code_artifact (suy ra tu doc code/schema, khong phai phat bieu nghiep vu tuong minh).
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Theo luat 'phanh derivation' cua C5, STRONG chi hop le khi MOI oracle kb_id deu CONFIRMED_EXPECTED va derivation=prose. Ha xuong BASELINE cho toi khi PO/Dev xac nhan hanh vi nay dung la chu y thiet ke, khong phai tac dung phu cua viec doc code.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] He thong co chan affiliate tao nhieu Invoice pending song song khong
checks.precondition: Affiliate co balance du de tao >1 Invoice lien tiep (vi du tao Invoice dau tien chi dung mot phan balance, sau do co them balance moi tu Conversion, roi tao Invoice thu 2 khi Invoice dau van con pending).
steps: Tao Invoice #1 (status pending) dung mot phan balance.
Them balance moi cho affiliate (vd 1 Conversion moi).
Thu tao Invoice #2 trong khi Invoice #1 van con pending.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua cua lan tao Invoice #2 va danh sach Invoice pending cua affiliate.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi co 1 claim hedged (da bi normalizer loai) suy luan rang tru balance ngay luc pending CO THE ngan duoc nhieu Invoice pending song song, nhung khong co xac nhan truc tiep. Can PO/dev xac nhan co co che chan ro rang hay khong.

open_question_draft.summary: He thong co chan affiliate tao nhieu Invoice o trang thai pending cung luc khong, hay chi dua vao viec balance bi tru ngay de 'gian tiep' han che so luong?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Neu cho phep nhieu Invoice pending song song, Ops can biet de xu ly dung thu tu va tranh nham lan khi doi soat; day la gap da duoc chinh tai lieu nguon tu nhan la hedged/chua xac nhan PO.

checks.title: Khong co cron/job nen nao tu dong tao Invoice - luon do affiliate tu chu dong
checks.precondition: Affiliate co balance tich luy qua nhieu ngay/ky, KHONG thuc hien hanh dong 'Request Payment' nao.
steps: De affiliate co balance tich luy qua it nhat 1 'ky' du lieu (vd qua 1 thang, hoac mo phong thoi gian he thong neu co the).
Khong thuc hien bat ky hanh dong Request Payment nao.
Kiem tra danh sach Invoice cua affiliate do.
checks.observation_point: Danh sach Invoice cua affiliate sau khoang thoi gian khong co hanh dong nao.
checks.expected_result: KHONG co Invoice moi nao duoc he thong tu sinh; so Invoice van giu nguyen nhu truoc khoang thoi gian theo doi (khong co cron/service nao tu dong tong hop/xuat Invoice theo chu ky).

checks.title: Moi khoan rut tao ra dung 1 Invoice duy nhat; affiliate tu quyet dinh khi nao va rut bao nhieu
checks.precondition: Affiliate du dieu kien canCreateByUser, co balance du.
steps: Thuc hien 1 lan gui yeu cau thanh toan voi amount tuy chon (trong gioi han balance).
Kiem tra so luong Invoice moi duoc tao.
checks.observation_point: So luong Invoice moi sinh ra sau 1 lan gui yeu cau.
checks.expected_result: Dung 1 Invoice duoc tao cho 1 lan gui yeu cau, bat ke amount la bao nhieu (trong gioi han balance).
